content.en: National income accounting measures the economic activity of a nation. Key metrics include **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**, which is the total market value of all final goods and services produced within the domestic territory of a country. **Gross National Product (GNP)** includes net factor income from abroad, while **Net National Product (NNP)** accounts for depreciation.
